Every cell contains ONLY ONE finished home-cooked dish from the ordered list. Read LEFT TO RIGHT then TOP TO BOTTOM. Even identical cell sizes, no grid lines. No words, labels, numbers, watermarks, cutlery, hands, extra sides, raw meats, duplicates or cell overlaps. All 20 specified dishes in exact order; each fits wholly inside its own cell.
